seo_desc: A free YouTube course for beginners: shoot on the phone you already have, fix light and sound for almost nothing, edit for free, write titles and thumbnails people click, and learn how creators get paid.
faq: Is the YouTube course really free?
Yes. Every lesson, quiz and game is free, with no sign-up. Your progress is saved in your own browser.
Do I need an expensive camera?
No. The course is written for the phone you already have, plus a few cheap extras if and when you want them.
How long does it take?
About an hour in total. Each lesson takes five or six minutes and ends with a three-question quiz.

title: Brand identity in a weekend
short: Build a brand that holds together
desc: The one sentence your brand stands on, a logo that survives at 16 pixels, and a colour and type system people (and AI tools) can follow.
seo_title: Free brand identity course for small businesses: positioning, logo, colour and type
seo_desc: A free short course on brand identity for small businesses and startups: write a positioning sentence, design a logo that works at 16 pixels, and build a colour and type system that people and AI tools can follow.
faq: Is this brand identity course free?
Yes, completely, with no sign-up. Each lesson takes about five minutes and ends with a short quiz.
Do I need design software?
No. You can do the exercises on paper, in Canva, Figma or the free Affinity apps.
Can I build my brand identity in a weekend?
You can build the foundations: the positioning sentence, a tested logo set and a written colour and type system. Polishing usually takes longer, and that is normal.

title: Get found in AI answers
desc: How ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google’s AI pick what to quote, how to write answer-first pages, and the proof that earns trust.
seo_title: Free GEO course: how to get your brand cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI answers
seo_desc: A free course on generative engine optimisation (GEO) for small brands: how AI search tools pick sources, how to write answer-first pages, and the proof, structure and freshness that get you quoted in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI answers.
faq: What is GEO?
Generative engine optimisation: making your pages easy for AI search tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google’s AI features to find, trust and quote.
Is this GEO course free?
Yes, free and without sign-up. Three short lessons and a quiz.
Does GEO replace SEO?
No. It builds on it. Pages still need to be crawlable and indexed; GEO is about being clear, credible and quotable once they are.
